blocks.content: This chapter covers Puducherry-specific development initiatives and its tourism circuit — anchored, as established in Chapter 9, around the French heritage quarter and Auroville, but extending across all four regions.

The current UT administration's stated development vision, articulated in the Lieutenant Governor's 2025 Budget Session address (Chapter 6-7), explicitly frames Puducherry's development goal as transforming it into a combined 'Business, Education, Spiritual and Tourist hub' — a formulation that captures the UT's distinctive multi-sector development strategy, leveraging its manufacturing base (Business), its established higher-education institutions (Education), Auroville and the Aurobindo Ashram (Spiritual), and its heritage/beach tourism assets (Tourist).

Central flagship schemes (Ayushman Bharat, PM Awas Yojana, Swachh Bharat Mission, Jal Jeevan Mission) have been extended to Puducherry alongside UT-specific welfare and infrastructure schemes, with the UT administration periodically highlighting coverage/saturation milestones in official communications.

cells: Grid-planned colonial streets, heritage villas, Puducherry Museum, French War Memorial, seafront promenade (Goubert Avenue)
Beaches, temples (including the notable Karaikal Ammaiyar-linked Shaivite heritage), and a distinct Tamil coastal-town character
Riverside setting, distinctive Malabar-coast character, historically known for duty-differential retail trade
Godavari-delta riverside town, distinctive Telugu-coastal character, French-era heritage buildings

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: Karaikal is historically associated with Karaikal Ammaiyar, one of the most revered women saints of the Tamil Shaivite (Nayanar) devotional tradition — a culture-history crossover fact linking the region to wider Tamil devotional literature predating the French colonial period covered in Chapter 3.

items: UT development vision (2025): transforming Puducherry into a 'Business, Education, Spiritual and Tourist hub'.
Tourism circuit: White Town (Puducherry), Sri Aurobindo Ashram, Auroville/Matrimandir, Paradise/Serenity Beach — plus distinct Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam attractions.
Karaikal is associated with Karaikal Ammaiyar, a revered Tamil Shaivite (Nayanar) woman saint.
